title: Read-only shell check: admit `git merge-base` (a read-only Git query) to the allow-list
outcome: Read-only reviewers and evaluators can run `git merge-base` (for example `--is-ancestor A B` to check that a commit is in a branch) without a refusal, with the same safety rules as the other admitted read-only Git subcommands.
acceptance: `git merge-base` with its read-only forms (`A B`, `--is-ancestor A B`, `--all`, `--octopus`, `--independent`, `--fork-point`) is admitted by the read-only check, under the same rules as other admitted Git subcommands (no -C or --git-dir unless those are admitted, no redirection to files); a test covers admitted and refused forms.
